show.title: Coolie’s Diamond Bride

show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Ca93GS
show.description: A chance meeting at a railway station brings together Arya, a humble coolie, and Akanksha, the daughter of a powerful diamond tycoon. When Akanksha chooses love over wealth and society, Arya is humiliated, tested, and pushed to his limits. As secrets unravel, the world discovers that true worth is not defined by status or money but by courage, integrity, and love. This is a romantic drama where a “coolie” becomes a king, and love proves to be the rarest diamond of all.
